PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 12th April, 2022 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No. KP/22 of 2022 /PRR /102014 /77 /KH: In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (5) of section 227 read 
with section 274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj:18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat hereby makes the 
following rules further to amend the Multi Purpose Health Worker (Male), Class III in the Superior Panchayat Service, 
Recruitment Rules 2022 namely:- 
1. These rules may be called the Multi Purpose Health Worker (Male), Class III in the Superior Panchayat Service, 
Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, 2022.  
2. In the Multi Purpose Health Worker (Male) Class III in the Superior Panchayat Service Recruitment Rules, 2022, in 
rule 3, in clause (a) after the existing provisos, the following proviso shall be inserted, namely:- 
"Provided that the upper age limit shall not be applicable in case of a candidate who is appointed as a Multi 
Purpose Health Worker (Male), Class III, in the Superior Panchayat Service either on contract basis on fixed pay for 
a fixed period or on adhoc basis in regular pay- scale but for a fixed period, and who possesses the qualifications as 
prescribed in clause (b) of this rule and who offers his candidature in respect of advertisement which may be 
published in the year 2022;" 
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat, 
HITESH GOHIL, 
Deputy Secretary to Government.
